import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"
import semantic = "./semantic.qui"

class Instruction(string op, int[] operands, lexer.Position position, callee := -1)
class Unit(string name, int function, int[] slots, Instruction[] code)
class Label(position := -1, int[] patches := [])
class Context(semantic.Context model, Instruction[] code := [], Label[] labels := [])
class Generated(semantic.Context model, Unit[] units, int area)
class Flat(Instruction[] instructions, int[] owners, int[] starts)

void emit(Context &context, string op, const int[] operands, const lexer.Position position, callee := -1)
    context.code = context.code.append(Instruction(op, operands, position, callee))

int new_label(Context &context)
    index := int(#context.labels)
    context.labels = context.labels.append(Label())
    return index

void jump(Context &context, string op, int label, const lexer.Position position)
    index := int(#context.code)
    target := context.labels[label].position
    emit(&context, op, [if target < 0 then 0 else target], position)
    if target < 0
        context.labels[label].patches = context.labels[label].patches.append(index)

void mark(Context &context, int label)
    context.labels[label].position = int(#context.code)
    patches := context.labels[label].patches
    for index := patches[]
        context.code[index].operands[0] = int(#context.code)

string binary_opcode(string operator)
    operators := ["+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "==", "!="]
    opcodes := ["ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"]
    for: index < int(#operators)
        if operators[index] == operator
            return opcodes[index]
    return ""

int | error array_size(const parser.Variable variable)
    match variable.size
        int size
            return size
        none
            return error("missing array size")

void generate_expression(Context &context, int index)
    parser.Expr expression := context.model.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "integer"
        value := int(expression.value)
        emit(&context, "PUSH", [value], expression.position)
    elif expression.kind == "bool"
        emit(&context, "PUSH", [if expression.value == "true" then 1 else 0], expression.position)
    elif expression.kind == "read"
        emit(&context, "READ", [], expression.position)
    elif expression.kind == "variable" or expression.kind == "element"
        semantic.Symbol symbol := context.model.symbols[expression.reference]
        parser.Variable variable := context.model.program.syntax.variables[symbol.index]
        if expression.kind == "element"
            generate_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
            size := array_size(variable)
            emit(&context, "LOADA", [variable.address, size], expression.position)
        else
            emit(&context, if variable.address >= 0 then "LOADG" else "LOADL", [if variable.address >= 0 then variable.address else variable.slot], expression.position)
    elif expression.kind == "call"
        for child := expression.children[]
            generate_expression(&context, child)
        emit(&context, "CALL", [0, int(#expression.children)], expression.position, expression.reference)
    elif expression.kind == "unary"
        generate_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
        emit(&context, if expression.value == "-" then "NEG" else "NOT", [], expression.position)
    else
        generate_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
        if expression.value == "&&" or expression.value == "||"
            alternative := new_label(&context)
            end := new_label(&context)
            jump(&context, if expression.value == "&&" then "JUMPF" else "JUMPT", alternative, expression.position)
            generate_expression(&context, expression.children[1])
            jump(&context, "JUMP", end, expression.position)
            mark(&context, alternative)
            emit(&context, "PUSH", [if expression.value == "&&" then 0 else 1], expression.position)
            mark(&context, end)
        else
            generate_expression(&context, expression.children[1])
            emit(&context, binary_opcode(expression.value), [], expression.position)

void generate_statement(Context &context, int index, break_label := -1, continue_label := -1)
    parser.Stmt statement := context.model.program.syntax.statements[index]
    kind := statement.kind
    if kind == "empty"
        return
    if kind == "block"
        for child := statement.statements[]
            generate_statement(&context, child, break_label, continue_label)
    elif kind == "declaration"
        parser.Variable variable := context.model.program.syntax.variables[statement.variable]
        match variable.initializer
            int initial
                generate_expression(&context, initial)
            none
                emit(&context, "PUSH", [0], variable.name.position)
        emit(&context, "STOREL", [variable.slot], variable.name.position)
    elif kind == "assignment"
        semantic.Symbol symbol := context.model.symbols[statement.reference]
        parser.Variable variable := context.model.program.syntax.variables[symbol.index]
        indexed := false
        match statement.index
            int expression_index
                indexed = true
                generate_expression(&context, expression_index)
            none
                indexed = false
        generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        if indexed
            size := array_size(variable)
            emit(&context, "STOREA", [variable.address, size], statement.position)
        else
            emit(&context, if variable.address >= 0 then "STOREG" else "STOREL", [if variable.address >= 0 then variable.address else variable.slot], statement.position)
    elif kind == "call"
        generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        if context.model.program.syntax.expressions[statement.expressions[0]].type != "void"
            emit(&context, "POP", [], statement.position)
    elif kind == "print"
        for expression_index := statement.expressions[]
            generate_expression(&context, expression_index)
        emit(&context, "PRINT", [int(#statement.expressions)], statement.position)
    elif kind == "if"
        alternative := new_label(&context)
        generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        jump(&context, "JUMPF", alternative, statement.position)
        generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[0], break_label, continue_label)
        if #statement.statements > 1
            end := new_label(&context)
            jump(&context, "JUMP", end, statement.position)
            mark(&context, alternative)
            generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[1], break_label, continue_label)
            mark(&context, end)
        else
            mark(&context, alternative)
    elif kind == "while"
        start := new_label(&context)
        end := new_label(&context)
        mark(&context, start)
        generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        jump(&context, "JUMPF", end, statement.position)
        generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[0], end, start)
        jump(&context, "JUMP", start, statement.position)
        mark(&context, end)
    elif kind == "for"
        if statement.statements[0] >= 0
            generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[0], break_label, continue_label)
        start := new_label(&context)
        next := new_label(&context)
        end := new_label(&context)
        mark(&context, start)
        if statement.expressions[0] >= 0
            generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
            jump(&context, "JUMPF", end, statement.position)
        generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[2], end, next)
        mark(&context, next)
        if statement.statements[1] >= 0
            generate_statement(&context, statement.statements[1], break_label, continue_label)
        jump(&context, "JUMP", start, statement.position)
        mark(&context, end)
    elif kind == "break" or kind == "continue"
        jump(&context, "JUMP", if kind == "break" then break_label else continue_label, statement.position)
    elif kind == "return"
        if #statement.expressions > 0
            generate_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
            emit(&context, "RETV", [], statement.position)
        else
            emit(&context, "RET", [], statement.position)

int[] declarations(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Stmt statement := syntax.statements[index]
    if statement.kind == "declaration"
        return [statement.variable]
    int[] result := []
    for child := statement.statements[]
        if child >= 0
            result = result.concat(declarations(syntax, child))
    return result

Generated generate(const semantic.Context model, const int[] reachable)
    context := Context(model)
    area := 0
    for declaration := context.model.program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind == "variable"
            context.model.program.syntax.variables[declaration.index].address = area
            parser.Variable variable := context.model.program.syntax.variables[declaration.index]
            match variable.size
                int size
                    area += size
                none
                    area += 1
    for declaration := context.model.program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind != "variable"
            continue
        parser.Variable variable := context.model.program.syntax.variables[declaration.index]
        match variable.initializer
            int initial
                generate_expression(&context, initial)
                emit(&context, "STOREG", [variable.address], variable.name.position)
            none
                area = area
    entry := semantic.global_id(context.model, "main")
    semantic.Symbol entry_symbol := context.model.symbols[entry]
    emit(&context, "CALL", [0, 0], entry_symbol.name.position, entry)
    emit(&context, "HALT", [], entry_symbol.name.position)
    units := [Unit("<init>", -1, [], context.code)]
    for declaration := context.model.program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind != "function"
            continue
        parser.Function function := context.model.program.syntax.functions[declaration.index]
        if not lexer.has(reachable, function.id)
            continue
        local_variables := declarations(context.model.program.syntax, function.body)
        for: position < int(#local_variables)
            cursor := position
            while cursor > 0
                lexer.Position first := context.model.program.syntax.variables[local_variables[cursor]].name.position
                lexer.Position second := context.model.program.syntax.variables[local_variables[cursor - 1]].name.position
                if lexer.compare_position(first, second) >= 0
                    break
                saved := local_variables[cursor]
                local_variables[cursor] = local_variables[cursor - 1]
                local_variables[cursor - 1] = saved
                cursor -= 1
        int[] slots := function.parameters.concat(local_variables)
        for: position < int(#slots)
            context.model.program.syntax.variables[slots[position]].slot = position
        context.code = []
        context.labels = []
        emit(&context, "ENTER", [int(#slots)], function.name.position)
        generate_statement(&context, function.body)
        if function.type == "void"
            emit(&context, "RET", [], context.model.program.syntax.statements[function.body].close)
        units = units.append(Unit(function.name.text, declaration.index, slots, context.code))
    return Generated(context.model, units, area)

class Position(int line, int column)
    string text()
        return "{line}:{column}"

class Problem(string kind, Position position, string reason)
class Token(string kind, string text, Position position)
class SourceLine(int number, string text)

bool has<T>(const T[] items, T sought)
    for item := items[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

string repeat(string text, int count)
    result := ""
    for: iteration < count
        result += text
    return result

int compare_position(const Position first, const Position second)
    if first.line != second.line
        return if first.line < second.line then -1 else 1
    return if first.column < second.column then -1 elif first.column > second.column then 1 else 0

bool letter(string character)
    return (character.codepoints()[0] >= 97 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 122) or (character.codepoints()[0] >= 65 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 90)

bool digit(string character)
    return character.codepoints()[0] >= 48 and character.codepoints()[0] <= 57

Token[] | Problem lex(const SourceLine[] lines)
    text := ""
    Position[] positions := []
    for line := lines[]
        text += line.text + NL
        for: column < int(#line.text) + 1
            positions = positions.append(Position(line.number, column + 1))
    Token[] tokens := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        character := text[position]
        if character == " " or character == NL
            position += 1
            continue
        start := position
        kind := "symbol"
        remainder := text[position:<int(#text)]
        if remainder.starts_with("//")
            while position < int(#text) and text[position] != NL
                position += 1
            continue
        if remainder.starts_with("/*")
            finish := position + 2
            while finish + 1 < int(#text) and text[finish:<finish + 2] != "*/"
                finish += 1
            if finish + 1 >= int(#text)
                return Problem("lexical", positions[start], "unterminated comment")
            position = finish + 2
            continue
        if letter(character) or character == "_"
            position += 1
            while position < int(#text) and (letter(text[position]) or digit(text[position]) or text[position] == "_")
                position += 1
            kind = if has(["int", "bool", "void", "true", "false", "if", "else", "while", "for", "break", "continue", "return", "print", "read"], text[start:<position]) then "keyword" else "identifier"
        elif digit(character)
            position += 1
            while position < int(#text) and digit(text[position])
                position += 1
            number := int(text[start:<position])
            if number > 2147483647
                return Problem("lexical", positions[start], "integer literal too large")
            kind = "integer"
        elif position + 1 < int(#text) and has(["<=", ">=", "==", "!=", "&&", "||"], text[position:<position + 2])
            position += 2
        elif "+-*/%<>=!(){{}}[],;".contains(character)
            position += 1
        else
            return Problem("lexical", positions[start], "unexpected character '{character}'")
        tokens = tokens.append(Token(kind, text[start:<position], positions[start]))
    last := lines[-1]
    tokens = tokens.append(Token("end", "", Position(last.number, int(#last.text) + 1)))
    return tokens

import collections
import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"
import semantic = "./semantic.qui"
import codegen = "./codegen.qui"
import vm = "./vm.qui"

class Warning(lexer.Position position, string message)
class Folder(semantic.Context model, count := 0)
class Peephole(codegen.Instruction[] code, int[] counts)
class BasicBlock(int first, int last, int[] successors)
class SourceProgram(string name, lexer.SourceLine[] lines := [])
class Inputs(SourceProgram[] programs, string[] lines)
class Count(string name, int value)
class PairCount(int caller, int callee, int value)
class LineCount(int line, int value)

int[] reachable_from(int root, const int[][] calls)
    int[] seen := []
    pending := [root]
    while #pending != 0
        id := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        if not lexer.has(seen, id)
            seen = seen.append(id)
            pending = pending.concat(calls[id].sorted())
    return seen

void unreachable_warnings(const parser.Store syntax, int index, Warning[] &warnings)
    parser.Stmt statement := syntax.statements[index]
    if statement.kind == "block"
        for: position < int(#statement.statements)
            if not semantic.can_complete(syntax, statement.statements[position])
                if position + 1 < int(#statement.statements)
                    lexer.Position next := syntax.statements[statement.statements[position + 1]].position
                    warnings = warnings.append(Warning(next, "unreachable statement"))
                break
    for child := statement.statements[]
        if child >= 0
            unreachable_warnings(syntax, child, &warnings)

string[] warning_lines(const semantic.Context model, const int[] reachable)
    Warning[] warnings := []
    for symbol := model.symbols[]
        if symbol.kind == "variable" and symbol.reads == 0
            noun := if symbol.parameter then "parameter" else "variable"
            warnings = warnings.append(Warning(symbol.name.position, "unused {noun} '{symbol.name.text}'"))
        if symbol.kind == "function" and not lexer.has(reachable, model.program.syntax.functions[symbol.index].id)
            warnings = warnings.append(Warning(symbol.name.position, "function '{symbol.name.text}' is never called"))
    for declaration := model.program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind == "function"
            unreachable_warnings(model.program.syntax, model.program.syntax.functions[declaration.index].body, &warnings)
    for: position < int(#warnings)
        cursor := position
        while cursor > 0 and lexer.compare_position(warnings[cursor].position, warnings[cursor - 1].position) < 0
            saved := warnings[cursor]
            warnings[cursor] = warnings[cursor - 1]
            warnings[cursor - 1] = saved
            cursor -= 1
    string[] result := []
    for warning := warnings[]
        result = result.append("warning {warning.position.text()}: {warning.message}")
    return result

int | none literal(const Folder folder, int index)
    parser.Expr expression := folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind == "integer"
        value := int(expression.value)
        return value
    if expression.kind == "bool"
        return if expression.value == "true" then 1 else 0
    return none

bool is_boolean(const Folder folder, int index, bool value)
    parser.Expr expression := folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    return expression.kind == "bool" and (expression.value == "true") == value

bool is_integer(const Folder folder, int index, int value)
    parser.Expr expression := folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    if expression.kind != "integer"
        return false
    found := int(expression.value)
    return found == value

int made(Folder &folder, int old, int value, string type)
    parser.Expr previous := folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[old]
    kind := if type == "bool" then "bool" else "integer"
    text := if type == "bool" then (if value != 0 then "true" else "false") else string(value)
    index := int(#folder.model.program.syntax.expressions)
    folder.model.program.syntax.expressions = folder.model.program.syntax.expressions.append(parser.Expr(kind, previous.position, text, type = type))
    folder.count += 1
    return index

int | none calculated(string operator, int first, int second)
    if (operator == "/" or operator == "%") and second == 0
        return none
    result := 0
    if operator == "+"
        result = first + second
    elif operator == "-"
        result = first - second
    elif operator == "*"
        result = first * second
    elif operator == "/"
        result = first / second
    elif operator == "%"
        result = first - second * (first / second)
    else
        value := if operator == "<" then first < second elif operator == "<=" then first <= second elif operator == ">" then first > second elif operator == ">=" then first >= second elif operator == "==" then first == second elif operator == "!=" then first != second elif operator == "&&" then first != 0 and second != 0 else first != 0 or second != 0
        result = if value then 1 else 0
    if result < -2147483648 or result > 2147483647
        return none
    return result

int fold_expression(Folder &folder, int index)
    parser.Expr expression := folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    int[] children := []
    for child := expression.children[]
        children = children.append(fold_expression(&folder, child))
    folder.model.program.syntax.expressions[index].children = children
    expression.children = children
    if expression.kind == "unary"
        match literal(folder, children[0])
            int value
                result := if expression.value == "!" then (if value == 0 then 1 else 0) else -value
                if result >= -2147483648 and result <= 2147483647
                    return made(&folder, index, result, expression.type)
            none
                folder.count = folder.count
    elif expression.kind == "binary"
        first := children[0]
        second := children[1]
        match literal(folder, first)
            int left
                match literal(folder, second)
                    int right
                        match calculated(expression.value, left, right)
                            int result
                                return made(&folder, index, result, expression.type)
                            none
                                folder.count = folder.count
                    none
                        folder.count = folder.count
            none
                folder.count = folder.count
        if expression.value == "&&" and is_boolean(folder, first, false)
            return made(&folder, index, 0, "bool")
        if expression.value == "||" and is_boolean(folder, first, true)
            return made(&folder, index, 1, "bool")
        if (expression.value == "&&" and is_boolean(folder, first, true)) or (expression.value == "||" and is_boolean(folder, first, false)) or (expression.value == "+" and is_integer(folder, first, 0)) or (expression.value == "*" and is_integer(folder, first, 1))
            folder.count += 1
            return second
        if (lexer.has(["+", "-"], expression.value) and is_integer(folder, second, 0)) or (lexer.has(["*", "/"], expression.value) and is_integer(folder, second, 1)) or (expression.value == "&&" and is_boolean(folder, second, true)) or (expression.value == "||" and is_boolean(folder, second, false))
            folder.count += 1
            return first
    return index

int fold_statement(Folder &folder, int index)
    parser.Stmt statement := folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index]
    kind := statement.kind
    if kind == "declaration"
        match folder.model.program.syntax.variables[statement.variable].initializer
            int initial
                folded := fold_expression(&folder, initial)
                folder.model.program.syntax.variables[statement.variable].initializer = folded
            none
                folder.count = folder.count
        return index
    if kind == "if" or kind == "while"
        condition := fold_expression(&folder, statement.expressions[0])
        folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].expressions = [condition]
        if is_boolean(folder, condition, false)
            folder.count += 1
            if kind == "if" and #statement.statements > 1
                return fold_statement(&folder, statement.statements[1])
            folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index] = parser.Stmt("empty", statement.position)
            return index
        if kind == "if" and is_boolean(folder, condition, true)
            folder.count += 1
            return fold_statement(&folder, statement.statements[0])
        int[] children := []
        for child := statement.statements[]
            children = children.append(fold_statement(&folder, child))
        folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].statements = children
        return index
    if kind == "for"
        children := statement.statements
        if children[0] >= 0
            children[0] = fold_statement(&folder, children[0])
        condition := statement.expressions[0]
        if condition >= 0
            condition = fold_expression(&folder, condition)
        if children[1] >= 0
            children[1] = fold_statement(&folder, children[1])
        children[2] = fold_statement(&folder, children[2])
        folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].statements = children
        folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].expressions = [condition]
        return index
    match statement.index
        int expression_index
            folded := fold_expression(&folder, expression_index)
            folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].index = folded
        none
            folder.count = folder.count
    int[] expressions := []
    for expression_index := statement.expressions[]
        expressions = expressions.append(fold_expression(&folder, expression_index))
    folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].expressions = expressions
    int[] children := []
    for child := statement.statements[]
        if child >= 0
            children = children.append(fold_statement(&folder, child))
        else
            children = children.append(-1)
    folder.model.program.syntax.statements[index].statements = children
    return index

void fold_program(Folder &folder, const int[] reachable)
    parser.Top[] declarations := folder.model.program.declarations
    for declaration := declarations[]
        if declaration.kind == "variable"
            match folder.model.program.syntax.variables[declaration.index].initializer
                int initial
                    folded := fold_expression(&folder, initial)
                    folder.model.program.syntax.variables[declaration.index].initializer = folded
                none
                    folder.count = folder.count
        else
            parser.Function function := folder.model.program.syntax.functions[declaration.index]
            if lexer.has(reachable, function.id)
                folded := fold_statement(&folder, function.body)
                folder.model.program.syntax.functions[declaration.index].body = folded

string[] rule_names()
    return ["const-jump", "not-compare", "not-jump", "invert-branch", "thread", "jump-next", "unreachable"]

bool is_jump(string op)
    return lexer.has(["JUMP", "JUMPF", "JUMPT"], op)

bool conditional(string op)
    return op == "JUMPF" or op == "JUMPT"

bool transfer(string op)
    return lexer.has(["JUMP", "RET", "RETV", "HALT"], op)

bool jumps(string op, int value)
    return if op == "JUMPF" then value == 0 else value != 0

string inverse(string op)
    return if op == "JUMPF" then "JUMPT" else "JUMPF"

void delete_instruction(codegen.Instruction[] &code, int index)
    codegen.Instruction[] result := []
    for: position < int(#code)
        if position == index
            continue
        instruction := code[position]
        if is_jump(instruction.op) and instruction.operands[0] > index
            instruction.operands[0] -= 1
        result = result.append(instruction)
    code = result

Peephole peephole(const codegen.Instruction[] original)
    code := original
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    while true
        int[] targets := []
        for instruction := code[]
            if is_jump(instruction.op) and not lexer.has(targets, instruction.operands[0])
                targets = targets.append(instruction.operands[0])
        changed := false
        for: index < int(#code)
            first := code[index]
            free := index + 1 < int(#code) and not lexer.has(targets, index + 1)
            if free
                second := code[index + 1]
                if first.op == "PUSH" and conditional(second.op)
                    if jumps(second.op, first.operands[0])
                        code[index] = codegen.Instruction("JUMP", second.operands, second.position)
                        delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                    else
                        delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                        delete_instruction(&code, index)
                    counts[0] += 1
                    changed = true
                elif second.op == "NOT" and lexer.has(["LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"], first.op)
                    comparisons := ["LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"]
                    negations := ["GE", "GT", "LE", "LT", "NE", "EQ"]
                    for: position < 6
                        if first.op == comparisons[position]
                            code[index].op = negations[position]
                            break
                    delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                    counts[1] += 1
                    changed = true
                elif first.op == "NOT" and conditional(second.op)
                    code[index] = codegen.Instruction(inverse(second.op), second.operands, second.position)
                    delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                    counts[2] += 1
                    changed = true
                elif conditional(first.op) and first.operands[0] == index + 2 and second.op == "JUMP"
                    code[index] = codegen.Instruction(inverse(first.op), second.operands, first.position)
                    delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                    counts[3] += 1
                    changed = true
            if changed
                break
            int | none new_target := none
            if is_jump(first.op) and first.operands[0] < int(#code)
                target := first.operands[0]
                at := code[target]
                if at.op == "JUMP"
                    new_target = at.operands[0]
                elif at.op == "PUSH" and target + 1 < int(#code) and conditional(code[target + 1].op)
                    new_target = if jumps(code[target + 1].op, at.operands[0]) then code[target + 1].operands[0] else target + 2
            match new_target
                int target
                    if target != first.operands[0]
                        code[index].operands[0] = target
                        counts[4] += 1
                        changed = true
                none
                    changed = false
            if changed
                break
            if is_jump(first.op) and first.operands[0] == index + 1
                if first.op == "JUMP"
                    delete_instruction(&code, index)
                else
                    code[index] = codegen.Instruction("POP", [], first.position)
                counts[5] += 1
                changed = true
            elif free and transfer(first.op)
                delete_instruction(&code, index + 1)
                counts[6] += 1
                changed = true
            if changed
                break
        if not changed
            return Peephole(code, counts)

int[] successors(const codegen.Instruction[] code, int index)
    instruction := code[index]
    int[] result := []
    if not transfer(instruction.op) and index + 1 < int(#code)
        result = result.append(index + 1)
    if is_jump(instruction.op) and instruction.operands[0] < int(#code) and not lexer.has(result, instruction.operands[0])
        result = result.append(instruction.operands[0])
    return result

BasicBlock[] basic_blocks(const codegen.Instruction[] code)
    leaders := [0]
    for: index < int(#code)
        instruction := code[index]
        if is_jump(instruction.op) and instruction.operands[0] < int(#code) and not lexer.has(leaders, instruction.operands[0])
            leaders = leaders.append(instruction.operands[0])
        if (is_jump(instruction.op) or transfer(instruction.op)) and index + 1 < int(#code) and not lexer.has(leaders, index + 1)
            leaders = leaders.append(index + 1)
    leaders = leaders.sorted()
    numbering := array(#code, fill = -1)
    for: block_index < int(#leaders)
        numbering[leaders[block_index]] = block_index
    BasicBlock[] result := []
    for: block_index < int(#leaders)
        first := leaders[block_index]
        last := if block_index + 1 < int(#leaders) then leaders[block_index + 1] - 1 else int(#code) - 1
        next := successors(code, last)
        int[] block_successors := []
        for target := next[]
            block_successors = block_successors.append(numbering[target])
        result = result.append(BasicBlock(first, last, block_successors))
    return result

int stack_effect(const codegen.Instruction instruction, const semantic.Context model)
    op := instruction.op
    if lexer.has(["PUSH", "LOADG", "LOADL", "READ"], op)
        return 1
    if lexer.has(["POP", "STOREG", "STOREL", "JUMPF", "JUMPT", "RETV", "ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD", "LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"], op)
        return -1
    if op == "STOREA"
        return -2
    if op == "CALL"
        return -instruction.operands[1] + (if model.symbols[instruction.callee].type == "void" then 0 else 1)
    if op == "PRINT"
        return -instruction.operands[0]
    return 0

int stack_depth(const codegen.Instruction[] code, const semantic.Context model)
    depths := array(#code, fill = -1)
    depths[0] = 0
    pending := [0]
    maximum := 0
    while #pending != 0
        index := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        next_depth := depths[index] + stack_effect(code[index], model)
        maximum = lexer.maximum(maximum, next_depth)
        next := successors(code, index)
        for target := next[]
            if depths[target] < 0
                depths[target] = next_depth
                pending = pending.append(target)
    return maximum

codegen.Flat flatten(const codegen.Unit[] units, const semantic.Context model)
    int[] starts := []
    function_starts := array(#model.symbols, fill = -1)
    address := 0
    for unit := units[]
        starts = starts.append(address)
        if unit.function >= 0
            function_starts[model.program.syntax.functions[unit.function].id] = address
        address += int(#unit.code)
    codegen.Instruction[] instructions := []
    int[] owners := []
    for: unit_index < int(#units)
        unit := units[unit_index]
        for original := unit.code[]
            codegen.Instruction instruction := original
            if is_jump(instruction.op)
                instruction.operands[0] += starts[unit_index]
            if instruction.op == "CALL"
                instruction.operands[0] = function_starts[instruction.callee]
            instructions = instructions.append(instruction)
            owners = owners.append(unit_index)
    return codegen.Flat(instructions, owners, starts)

string spelling(const codegen.Instruction instruction)
    result := instruction.op
    for operand := instruction.operands[]
        result += " {operand}"
    return result

string pad(string text, int width, left := false)
    spaces := lexer.repeat(" ", width - int(#text))
    return if left then text + spaces else spaces + text

int[] unique_numbers(const int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        if not lexer.has(result, value)
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

string numbers(const int[] values, string empty)
    string[] words := []
    for value := values[]
        words = words.append(string(value))
    return if #words == 0 then empty else words.join(" ")

string[] listing_lines(const semantic.Context model, const codegen.Unit[] before, const codegen.Unit[] after, const codegen.Flat old_code, const codegen.Flat new_code)
    int[] globals := []
    int[] functions := []
    for declaration := model.program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind == "variable"
            globals = globals.append(declaration.index)
        else
            functions = functions.append(declaration.index)
    lines := [if #globals == 0 then "globals: none" else "globals:"]
    for index := globals[]
        parser.Variable variable := model.program.syntax.variables[index]
        type := variable.type
        match variable.size
            int size
                type = "int[{size}]"
            none
                type = type
        lines = lines.append("  {variable.address} {variable.name.text} {type}")
    lines = lines.append("functions:")
    for: unit_index < int(#after)
        unit := after[unit_index]
        signature := ""
        callees := ["main"]
        recursive := false
        if unit.function >= 0
            parser.Function function := model.program.syntax.functions[unit.function]
            string[] parameter_types := []
            for parameter := function.parameters[]
                parameter_types = parameter_types.append(model.program.syntax.variables[parameter].type)
            signature = " {function.type}({parameter_types.join(",")})"
            callees = []
            for id := model.calls[function.id][]
                callees = callees.append(model.symbols[id].name.text)
                if lexer.has(reachable_from(id, model.calls), function.id)
                    recursive = true
            callees = callees.sorted()
        calls_text := if #callees == 0 then "-" else callees.join(",")
        recursive_text := if recursive then " recursive" else ""
        blocks := basic_blocks(unit.code)
        lines = lines.append("  {unit.name}{signature} address={old_code.starts[unit_index]}->{new_code.starts[unit_index]} size={#before[unit_index].code}->{#unit.code} slots={#unit.slots} stack={stack_depth(unit.code, model)} blocks={#blocks} calls={calls_text}{recursive_text}")
        for: slot < int(#unit.slots)
            parser.Variable variable := model.program.syntax.variables[unit.slots[slot]]
            lines = lines.append("    slot {slot} {variable.name.text} {variable.type}")
    lines = lines.append("references:")
    int[] referents := []
    for index := globals[]
        referents = referents.append(model.program.syntax.variables[index].id)
    for index := functions[]
        referents = referents.append(model.program.syntax.functions[index].id)
    for id := referents[]
        semantic.Symbol symbol := model.symbols[id]
        int[] used := []
        for position := symbol.references[]
            used = used.append(position.line)
        used = unique_numbers(used).sorted()
        lines = lines.append("  {symbol.name.text} defined {symbol.name.position.line} used {numbers(used, "-")}")
    for: version < 2
        heading := if version == 0 then "before" else "after"
        units := if version == 0 then before else after
        flat := if version == 0 then old_code else new_code
        lines = lines.append("{heading} peephole: {#flat.instructions} instructions")
        for: unit_index < int(#units)
            lines = lines.append(units[unit_index].name + ":")
            for: index < int(#units[unit_index].code)
                pc := flat.starts[unit_index] + index
                lines = lines.append(pad(string(pc), 5) + "  " + spelling(flat.instructions[pc]))
    lines = lines.append("control flow:")
    for: unit_index < int(#after)
        unit := after[unit_index]
        lines = lines.append("  {unit.name}")
        blocks := basic_blocks(unit.code)
        for: index < int(#blocks)
            block := blocks[index]
            string[] names := []
            for target := block.successors[]
                names = names.append("B{target}")
            suffix := if #names == 0 then "" else " -> {names.join(" ")}"
            lines = lines.append("    B{index} {new_code.starts[unit_index] + block.first}-{new_code.starts[unit_index] + block.last}{suffix}")
    return lines

int get_count<K>(const map<K, int> table, K key)
    match table.get(key)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return 0

Count[] sorted_counts(const map<string, int> values)
    Count[] result := []
    keys := values.keys()
    for key := keys[]
        count := get_count(values, key)
        if count > 0
            result = result.append(Count(key, count))
    for: index < int(#result)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := result[cursor]
            second := result[cursor - 1]
            if first.value < second.value or (first.value == second.value and collections.lex_compare(first.name.codepoints(), second.name.codepoints()) >= 0)
                break
            result[cursor] = second
            result[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    return result

bool same_message(const string | none first, const string | none second)
    match first
        string left
            match second
                string right
                    return left == right
                none
                    return false
        none
            match second
                string right
                    return false
                none
                    return true

string[] stats_lines(int before_count, const codegen.Unit[] after, const codegen.Flat code, const vm.Result main_run, const vm.Result comparison, int folds, const int[] rules)
    peephole_count := 0
    for count := rules[]
        peephole_count += count
    lines := ["code: {before_count} -> {#code.instructions}", "folds: {folds}", "peephole: {peephole_count}"]
    names := rule_names()
    for: index < int(#names)
        lines = lines.append("  {names[index]} {rules[index]}")
    same := main_run.output == comparison.output and same_message(main_run.message, comparison.message)
    behavior := if same then "same" else "different"
    lines = lines.concat(["executed: {main_run.executed}", "executed before peephole: {comparison.executed}", "behaviour: {behavior}", "max call depth: {main_run.max_depth}", "max stack: {main_run.max_stack}", "opcodes:"])
    map<string, int> opcodes
    unit_counts := array(#after, fill = 0)
    map<int, int> line_counts
    for: pc < int(#code.instructions)
        codegen.Instruction instruction := code.instructions[pc]
        count := main_run.counts[pc]
        .opcodes.set(instruction.op, get_count(opcodes, instruction.op) + count)
        unit_counts[code.owners[pc]] += count
        .line_counts.set(instruction.position.line, get_count(line_counts, instruction.position.line) + count)
    counts := sorted_counts(opcodes)
    for count := counts[]
        lines = lines.append("  {count.name} {count.value}")
    lines = lines.append("functions:")
    int[] unit_order := []
    for: 1 <= index < int(#after)
        unit_order = unit_order.append(index)
    for: index < int(#unit_order)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := unit_order[cursor]
            second := unit_order[cursor - 1]
            if unit_counts[first] < unit_counts[second] or (unit_counts[first] == unit_counts[second] and collections.lex_compare(after[first].name.codepoints(), after[second].name.codepoints()) >= 0)
                break
            unit_order[cursor] = second
            unit_order[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    for index := unit_order[]
        lines = lines.append("  {after[index].name} calls={main_run.calls[index]} executed={unit_counts[index]}")
    lines = lines.append("calls:")
    PairCount[] pairs := []
    for: caller < int(#after)
        for: callee < int(#after)
            if main_run.edges[caller][callee] > 0
                pairs = pairs.append(PairCount(caller, callee, main_run.edges[caller][callee]))
    for: index < int(#pairs)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := pairs[cursor]
            second := pairs[cursor - 1]
            before := first.value > second.value or (first.value == second.value and (collections.lex_compare(after[first.caller].name.codepoints(), after[second.caller].name.codepoints()) < 0 or (after[first.caller].name == after[second.caller].name and collections.lex_compare(after[first.callee].name.codepoints(), after[second.callee].name.codepoints()) < 0)))
            if not before
                break
            pairs[cursor] = second
            pairs[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    for pair := pairs[]
        lines = lines.append("  {after[pair.caller].name} -> {after[pair.callee].name} {pair.value}")
    lines = lines.append("hot lines:")
    LineCount[] hot := []
    int[] missing := []
    line_numbers := line_counts.keys()
    for line := line_numbers[]
        count := get_count(line_counts, line)
        if count > 0
            hot = hot.append(LineCount(line, count))
        else
            missing = missing.append(line)
    for: index < int(#hot)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := hot[cursor]
            second := hot[cursor - 1]
            if first.value < second.value or (first.value == second.value and first.line >= second.line)
                break
            hot[cursor] = second
            hot[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    for: index < lexer.minimum(5, int(#hot))
        lines = lines.append("  line {hot[index].line}: {hot[index].value}")
    lines = lines.concat(["coverage: {#hot} of {line_counts.size()} lines", "not executed: {numbers(missing.sorted(), "none")}", "hot spots:"])
    int[] addresses := []
    for: pc < int(#code.instructions)
        if main_run.counts[pc] > 0
            addresses = addresses.append(pc)
    for: index < int(#addresses)
        cursor := index
        while cursor > 0
            first := addresses[cursor]
            second := addresses[cursor - 1]
            if main_run.counts[first] < main_run.counts[second] or (main_run.counts[first] == main_run.counts[second] and first >= second)
                break
            addresses[cursor] = second
            addresses[cursor - 1] = first
            cursor -= 1
    for: index < lexer.minimum(5, int(#addresses))
        pc := addresses[index]
        lines = lines.append("  pc={pc} count={main_run.counts[pc]} {spelling(code.instructions[pc])}")
    return lines

Inputs read_programs()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/program.src"))
    all_lines := text.split(NL)
    lines := all_lines[0:<int(#all_lines) - 1]
    SourceProgram[] programs := []
    for: position < int(#lines)
        line := lines[position]
        if line.starts_with("#program ")
            programs = programs.append(SourceProgram(line[9:<int(#line)]))
        else
            last := int(#programs) - 1
            programs[last].lines = programs[last].lines.append(lexer.SourceLine(position + 1, line))
    return Inputs(programs, lines)

int[] input_for(const map<string, int[]> values, string name)
    match values.get(name)
        int[] found
            return found
        none
            return []

map<string, int[]> read_input()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/input.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    map<string, int[]> result
    current := ""
    for line := lines[]
        if line == ""
            continue
        if line.starts_with("#input ")
            current = line[7:<int(#line)]
            .result.set(current, [])
        else
            values := input_for(result, current)
            words := line.split(" ")
            for word := words[]
                value := int(word)
                values = values.append(value)
            .result.set(current, values)
    return result

string[] position_display(const lexer.Position position, const string[] sources)
    return ["  " + sources[position.line - 1], lexer.repeat(" ", position.column + 1) + "^"]

semantic.Context | lexer.Problem compile_source(const SourceProgram source)
    lexer.Token[] tokens
    match lexer.lex(source.lines)
        lexer.Token[] found
            tokens = found
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
    parser.Program program
    match parser.parse(tokens)
        parser.Program found
            program = found
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
    model := semantic.analyze(program)
    match model.problem
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            return model

void write_output(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/{name}")
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    data := read_programs()
    inputs := read_input()
    string[] listing := []
    string[] output := []
    string[] diagnostics := []
    string[] stats := []
    string[][] rows := [["program", "status", "code", "executed", "output"]]
    compiled := 0
    compile_errors := [0, 0, 0]
    runtime_errors := 0
    fold_total := 0
    rule_totals := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    executed_total := 0
    for source := data.programs[]
        heading := "== program {source.name} =="
        listing = listing.append(heading)
        output = output.append(heading)
        diagnostics = diagnostics.append(heading)
        stats = stats.append(heading)
        match compile_source(source)
            lexer.Problem problem
                listing = listing.append("not compiled")
                stats = stats.append("not compiled")
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("{problem.kind} error {problem.position.text()}: {problem.reason}")
                diagnostics = diagnostics.concat(position_display(problem.position, data.lines)).append("status: compile error")
                index := if problem.kind == "lexical" then 0 elif problem.kind == "syntax" then 1 else 2
                compile_errors[index] += 1
                rows = rows.append([source.name, problem.kind + " error", "-", "-", "-"])
            semantic.Context model
                compiled += 1
                entry := semantic.global_id(model, "main")
                reachable := reachable_from(entry, model.calls)
                diagnostics = diagnostics.concat(warning_lines(model, reachable))
                folder := Folder(model)
                fold_program(&folder, reachable)
                fold_total += folder.count
                generated := codegen.generate(folder.model, reachable)
                codegen.Unit[] before := generated.units
                codegen.Unit[] after := []
                rules := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
                for original := before[]
                    result := peephole(original.code)
                    unit := original
                    unit.code = result.code
                    after = after.append(unit)
                    for: index < 7
                        rules[index] += result.counts[index]
                for: index < 7
                    rule_totals[index] += rules[index]
                old_code := flatten(before, generated.model)
                new_code := flatten(after, generated.model)
                input := input_for(inputs, source.name)
                main_run := vm.run(new_code, generated.area, input)
                comparison := vm.run(old_code, generated.area, input)
                executed_total += main_run.executed
                listing = listing.concat(listing_lines(generated.model, before, after, old_code, new_code))
                output = output.concat(main_run.output)
                status := "ok"
                match main_run.error_pc
                    int pc
                        runtime_errors += 1
                        status = "runtime error"
                        codegen.Instruction instruction := new_code.instructions[pc]
                        message := ""
                        match main_run.message
                            string found
                                message = found
                            none
                                message = ""
                        diagnostics = diagnostics.append("runtime error {instruction.position.text()}: {message} in {after[new_code.owners[pc]].name}")
                        diagnostics = diagnostics.concat(position_display(instruction.position, data.lines))
                        for: index < lexer.minimum(5, int(#main_run.callers))
                            caller := main_run.callers[index]
                            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("  called from {after[new_code.owners[caller]].name} at {new_code.instructions[caller].position.text()}")
                        if #main_run.callers > 5
                            diagnostics = diagnostics.append("  ... {int(#main_run.callers) - 5} more")
                    none
                        status = "ok"
                diagnostics = diagnostics.append("status: {status}")
                stats = stats.concat(stats_lines(int(#old_code.instructions), after, new_code, main_run, comparison, folder.count, rules))
                rows = rows.append([source.name, status, string(#new_code.instructions), string(main_run.executed), string(#main_run.output)])
    peephole_total := 0
    for count := rule_totals[]
        peephole_total += count
    stats = stats.concat(["== summary ==", "programs: {#data.programs}", "compiled: {compiled}", "compile errors: lexical {compile_errors[0]} syntax {compile_errors[1]} semantic {compile_errors[2]}", "runtime errors: {runtime_errors}", "folds: {fold_total}", "peephole: {peephole_total}"])
    names := rule_names()
    for: index < 7
        stats = stats.append("  {names[index]} {rule_totals[index]}")
    stats = stats.append("executed: {executed_total}")
    widths := [0, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    for row := rows[]
        for: column < 5
            widths[column] = lexer.maximum(widths[column], int(#row[column]))
    for row := rows[]
        string[] columns := []
        for: column < 5
            columns = columns.append(pad(row[column], widths[column], column < 2))
        stats = stats.append("  " + columns.join("  "))
    write_output("listing.txt", listing)
    write_output("output.txt", output)
    write_output("diagnostics.txt", diagnostics)
    write_output("stats.txt", stats)

if main
    run_program()

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"

class Name(string text, lexer.Position position)
class Variable(string type, Name name, int | none initializer := none, int | none size := none, lexer.Position | none size_position := none, id := -1, address := -1, slot := -1)
class Function(string type, Name name, int[] parameters, int body, id := -1)
class Top(string kind, int index)
class Expr(string kind, lexer.Position position, value := "", int[] children := [], reference := -1, type := "")
class Stmt(string kind, lexer.Position position, int[] statements := [], int[] expressions := [], variable := -1, name := Name("", lexer.Position(0, 0)), int | none index := none, close := lexer.Position(0, 0), reference := -1)
class Store(Variable[] variables := [], Function[] functions := [], Expr[] expressions := [], Stmt[] statements := [])
class Program(Store syntax, Top[] declarations, lexer.Position end)
class Parsing(lexer.Token[] tokens, position := 0, syntax := Store(), lexer.Problem | none problem := none)

bool failed(const Parsing context)
    match context.problem
        lexer.Problem found
            return true
        none
            return false

lexer.Token peek(const Parsing context)
    return context.tokens[context.position]

string word(const Parsing context)
    return peek(context).text

void failure(Parsing &context)
    if not failed(context)
        token := peek(context)
        reason := if token.kind == "end" then "unexpected end of program" else "unexpected '{token.text}'"
        context.problem = lexer.Problem("syntax", token.position, reason)

lexer.Token take(Parsing &context)
    token := peek(context)
    if token.kind != "end" and not failed(context)
        context.position += 1
    return token

lexer.Token expect(Parsing &context, string value)
    if word(context) != value
        failure(&context)
    return take(&context)

Name read_name(Parsing &context)
    if peek(context).kind != "identifier"
        failure(&context)
    token := take(&context)
    return Name(token.text, token.position)

bool is_type(string text)
    return lexer.has(["int", "bool", "void"], text)

string read_type(Parsing &context)
    if not is_type(word(context))
        failure(&context)
    token := take(&context)
    return token.text

int add_expression(Parsing &context, const Expr value)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.expressions)
    context.syntax.expressions = context.syntax.expressions.append(value)
    return index

int add_statement(Parsing &context, const Stmt value)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.statements)
    context.syntax.statements = context.syntax.statements.append(value)
    return index

int add_variable(Parsing &context, const Variable value)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    index := int(#context.syntax.variables)
    context.syntax.variables = context.syntax.variables.append(value)
    return index

int expression(Parsing &context, minimum := 1);
int statement(Parsing &context);

int[] arguments(Parsing &context)
    opening := expect(&context, "(")
    int[] values := []
    if not failed(context) and word(context) != ")"
        first := expression(&context)
        values = values.append(first)
        while not failed(context) and word(context) == ","
            comma := take(&context)
            next := expression(&context)
            values = values.append(next)
    closing := expect(&context, ")")
    return values

int primary(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    token := peek(context)
    if token.kind == "integer"
        consumed := take(&context)
        number := int(token.text)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("integer", token.position, string(number)))
    if token.text == "true" or token.text == "false"
        consumed := take(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("bool", token.position, token.text))
    if token.text == "read"
        consumed := take(&context)
        opening := expect(&context, "(")
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("read", token.position))
    if token.text == "("
        opening := take(&context)
        value := expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        return if failed(context) then -1 else value
    name := read_name(&context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    if word(context) == "("
        values := arguments(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("call", token.position, name.text, values))
    if word(context) == "["
        opening := take(&context)
        index := expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, "]")
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("element", token.position, name.text, [index]))
    return add_expression(&context, Expr("variable", token.position, name.text))

int unary(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    if word(context) == "-" or word(context) == "!"
        operator := take(&context)
        value := unary(&context)
        return add_expression(&context, Expr("unary", operator.position, operator.text, [value]))
    return primary(&context)

int priority(string operator)
    return if operator == "||" then 1 elif operator == "&&" then 2 elif operator == "==" or operator == "!=" then 3 elif lexer.has(["<", "<=", ">", ">="], operator) then 4 elif operator == "+" or operator == "-" then 5 elif lexer.has(["*", "/", "%"], operator) then 6 else 0

int expression(Parsing &context, int minimum)
    left := unary(&context)
    while not failed(context) and priority(word(context)) >= minimum
        operator := take(&context)
        right := expression(&context, priority(operator.text) + 1)
        left = add_expression(&context, Expr("binary", operator.position, operator.text, [left, right]))
    return left

int declaration(Parsing &context, bool required)
    lexer.Position position := peek(context).position
    type := read_type(&context)
    name := read_name(&context)
    int | none initial := none
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "="
        assignment := take(&context)
        initial = expression(&context)
    elif required
        assignment := expect(&context, "=")
    variable := add_variable(&context, Variable(type, name, initial))
    return add_statement(&context, Stmt("declaration", position, variable = variable))

int block(Parsing &context)
    opening := expect(&context, "{{")
    int[] statements := []
    while not failed(context) and word(context) != "}}"
        if is_type(word(context))
            child := declaration(&context, false)
            ending := expect(&context, ";")
            statements = statements.append(child)
        else
            child := statement(&context)
            statements = statements.append(child)
    closing := expect(&context, "}}")
    return add_statement(&context, Stmt("block", opening.position, statements = statements, close = closing.position))

int simple(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    lexer.Position position := peek(context).position
    if word(context) == "read"
        value := primary(&context)
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("call", position, expressions = [value]))
    name := read_name(&context)
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "("
        values := arguments(&context)
        value := add_expression(&context, Expr("call", position, name.text, values))
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("call", position, expressions = [value]))
    int | none index := none
    if not failed(context) and word(context) == "["
        opening := take(&context)
        index = expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, "]")
    assignment := expect(&context, "=")
    value := expression(&context)
    return add_statement(&context, Stmt("assignment", position, expressions = [value], name = name, index = index))

int statement(Parsing &context)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    lexer.Position position := peek(context).position
    kind := word(context)
    if kind == "{{"
        return block(&context)
    if kind == "if"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := expect(&context, "(")
        condition := expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        yes := statement(&context)
        children := [yes]
        if not failed(context) and word(context) == "else"
            alternative := take(&context)
            no := statement(&context)
            children = children.append(no)
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("if", position, children, [condition]))
    if kind == "while"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := expect(&context, "(")
        condition := expression(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        body := statement(&context)
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("while", position, [body], [condition]))
    if kind == "for"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := expect(&context, "(")
        initial := -1
        if word(context) != ";"
            initial = if is_type(word(context)) then declaration(&context, true) else simple(&context)
        first := expect(&context, ";")
        condition := -1
        if not failed(context) and word(context) != ";"
            condition = expression(&context)
        second := expect(&context, ";")
        update := -1
        if not failed(context) and word(context) != ")"
            update = simple(&context)
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        body := statement(&context)
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("for", position, [initial, update, body], [condition]))
    if kind == "break" or kind == "continue"
        keyword := take(&context)
        ending := expect(&context, ";")
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt(kind, position))
    if kind == "return"
        keyword := take(&context)
        int[] values := []
        if word(context) != ";"
            value := expression(&context)
            values = values.append(value)
        ending := expect(&context, ";")
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("return", position, expressions = values))
    if kind == "print"
        keyword := take(&context)
        opening := expect(&context, "(")
        values := [expression(&context)]
        while not failed(context) and word(context) == ","
            comma := take(&context)
            values = values.append(expression(&context))
        closing := expect(&context, ")")
        ending := expect(&context, ";")
        return add_statement(&context, Stmt("print", position, expressions = values))
    result := simple(&context)
    ending := expect(&context, ";")
    return result

Program | lexer.Problem parse(const lexer.Token[] tokens)
    context := Parsing(tokens)
    Top[] declarations := []
    while not failed(context) and peek(context).kind != "end"
        type := read_type(&context)
        name := read_name(&context)
        if not failed(context) and word(context) == "("
            opening := take(&context)
            int[] parameters := []
            if word(context) != ")"
                while not failed(context)
                    parameter_type := read_type(&context)
                    parameter_name := read_name(&context)
                    parameter := add_variable(&context, Variable(parameter_type, parameter_name))
                    parameters = parameters.append(parameter)
                    if word(context) != ","
                        break
                    comma := take(&context)
            closing := expect(&context, ")")
            body := block(&context)
            if not failed(context)
                index := int(#context.syntax.functions)
                context.syntax.functions = context.syntax.functions.append(Function(type, name, parameters, body))
                declarations = declarations.append(Top("function", index))
        else
            int | none initial := none
            int | none size := none
            lexer.Position | none size_position := none
            if word(context) == "["
                opening := take(&context)
                if peek(context).kind != "integer"
                    failure(&context)
                number := take(&context)
                if not failed(context)
                    size = int(number.text)
                    size_position = number.position
                closing := expect(&context, "]")
            elif word(context) == "="
                assignment := take(&context)
                initial = expression(&context)
            ending := expect(&context, ";")
            variable := add_variable(&context, Variable(type, name, initial, size, size_position))
            if not failed(context)
                declarations = declarations.append(Top("variable", variable))
    match context.problem
        lexer.Problem problem
            return problem
        none
            return Program(context.syntax, declarations, peek(context).position)

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import parser = "./parser.qui"

class Symbol(parser.Name name, string type, string kind, int index, parameter := false, lexer.Position[] references := [], reads := 0)
class Context(parser.Program program, Symbol[] symbols := [], globals := map<string, int>(), map<string, int>[] scopes := [], int[][] calls := [], current_function := -1, lexer.Problem | none problem := none)

bool failed(const Context context)
    match context.problem
        lexer.Problem problem
            return true
        none
            return false

void fail(Context &context, const lexer.Position position, string reason)
    if not failed(context)
        context.problem = lexer.Problem("semantic", position, reason)

bool can_complete(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Stmt statement := syntax.statements[index]
    if lexer.has(["return", "break", "continue"], statement.kind)
        return false
    if statement.kind == "block"
        for child := statement.statements[]
            if not can_complete(syntax, child)
                return false
        return true
    if statement.kind == "if"
        return #statement.statements == 1 or can_complete(syntax, statement.statements[0]) or can_complete(syntax, statement.statements[1])
    return true

int add_variable(Context &context, int index, parameter := false)
    id := int(#context.symbols)
    parser.Variable variable := context.program.syntax.variables[index]
    context.program.syntax.variables[index].id = id
    context.symbols = context.symbols.append(Symbol(variable.name, variable.type, "variable", index, parameter))
    context.calls = context.calls.append([])
    return id

int add_function(Context &context, int index)
    id := int(#context.symbols)
    parser.Function function := context.program.syntax.functions[index]
    context.program.syntax.functions[index].id = id
    context.symbols = context.symbols.append(Symbol(function.name, function.type, "function", index))
    context.calls = context.calls.append([])
    return id

lexer.Position[] forbidden(const parser.Store syntax, int index)
    parser.Expr expression := syntax.expressions[index]
    lexer.Position[] result := []
    if lexer.has(["variable", "element", "call", "read"], expression.kind)
        result = result.append(expression.position)
    for child := expression.children[]
        result = result.concat(forbidden(syntax, child))
    return result

int lookup(Context &context, const parser.Name name, bool read_access, call := false)
    id := -1
    scope_index := int(#context.scopes) - 1
    while scope_index >= 0
        match context.scopes[scope_index].get(name.text)
            int found
                id = found
            none
                id = id
        if id >= 0
            break
        scope_index -= 1
    if id < 0
        match context.globals.get(name.text)
            int found
                id = found
            none
                id = -1
    if id < 0
        noun := if call then "function" else "identifier"
        fail(&context, name.position, "undeclared {noun} '{name.text}'")
        return -1
    context.symbols[id].references = context.symbols[id].references.append(name.position)
    if read_access
        context.symbols[id].reads += 1
    return id

int find_variable(Context &context, const parser.Name name, bool array_access, bool read_access)
    id := lookup(&context, name, read_access)
    if failed(context)
        return -1
    symbol := context.symbols[id]
    if symbol.kind == "function"
        fail(&context, name.position, "'{name.text}' is a function, not a variable")
        return -1
    parser.Variable variable := context.program.syntax.variables[symbol.index]
    is_array := false
    match variable.size
        int size
            is_array = true
        none
            is_array = false
    if not array_access and is_array
        fail(&context, name.position, "array '{name.text}' used without index")
    elif array_access and not is_array
        fail(&context, name.position, "'{name.text}' is not an array")
    return if failed(context) then -1 else id

string check_expression(Context &context, int index, call_statement := false)
    if failed(context)
        return ""
    parser.Expr expression := context.program.syntax.expressions[index]
    type := ""
    if expression.kind == "integer" or expression.kind == "read"
        type = "int"
    elif expression.kind == "bool"
        type = "bool"
    elif expression.kind == "variable" or expression.kind == "element"
        id := find_variable(&context, parser.Name(expression.value, expression.position), expression.kind == "element", true)
        if failed(context)
            return ""
        context.program.syntax.expressions[index].reference = id
        type = context.symbols[id].type
        if expression.kind == "element"
            found := check_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
            if not failed(context) and found != "int"
                fail(&context, expression.position, "index of '{expression.value}' must be int")
            type = "int"
    elif expression.kind == "call"
        id := lookup(&context, parser.Name(expression.value, expression.position), true, true)
        if failed(context)
            return ""
        context.program.syntax.expressions[index].reference = id
        symbol := context.symbols[id]
        if symbol.kind != "function"
            fail(&context, expression.position, "'{expression.value}' is not a function")
            return ""
        parser.Function function := context.program.syntax.functions[symbol.index]
        if #expression.children != #function.parameters
            fail(&context, expression.position, "wrong number of arguments to '{expression.value}' (expected {#function.parameters}, found {#expression.children})")
            return ""
        for: position < int(#expression.children)
            found := check_expression(&context, expression.children[position])
            if failed(context)
                return ""
            string expected := context.program.syntax.variables[function.parameters[position]].type
            if found != expected
                fail(&context, expression.position, "argument {position + 1} of '{expression.value}' must be {expected}")
                return ""
        if not call_statement and function.type == "void"
            fail(&context, expression.position, "void function '{expression.value}' used as a value")
            return ""
        if context.current_function >= 0
            int caller := context.program.syntax.functions[context.current_function].id
            if not lexer.has(context.calls[caller], id)
                context.calls[caller] = context.calls[caller].append(id)
        type = function.type
    elif expression.kind == "unary"
        found := check_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
        if failed(context)
            return ""
        expected := if expression.value == "-" then "int" else "bool"
        if found != expected
            fail(&context, expression.position, "operator '{expression.value}' requires {expected} operand")
        type = found
    else
        first := check_expression(&context, expression.children[0])
        if failed(context)
            return ""
        second := check_expression(&context, expression.children[1])
        if failed(context)
            return ""
        if lexer.has(["+", "-", "*", "/", "%", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], expression.value)
            if first != "int" or second != "int"
                fail(&context, expression.position, "operator '{expression.value}' requires int operands")
            type = if lexer.has(["+", "-", "*", "/", "%"], expression.value) then "int" else "bool"
        elif expression.value == "==" or expression.value == "!="
            if first != second
                fail(&context, expression.position, "operator '{expression.value}' requires operands of the same type")
            type = "bool"
        else
            if first != "bool" or second != "bool"
                fail(&context, expression.position, "operator '{expression.value}' requires bool operands")
            type = "bool"
    if not failed(context)
        context.program.syntax.expressions[index].type = type
    return type

void check_statement(Context &context, int index, int loops)
    if failed(context)
        return
    parser.Stmt statement := context.program.syntax.statements[index]
    kind := statement.kind
    if kind == "declaration"
        parser.Variable variable := context.program.syntax.variables[statement.variable]
        if variable.type == "void"
            fail(&context, variable.name.position, "variable '{variable.name.text}' cannot have type void")
            return
        scope_index := int(#context.scopes) - 1
        if context.scopes[scope_index].has(variable.name.text)
            fail(&context, variable.name.position, "redeclaration of '{variable.name.text}'")
            return
        match variable.initializer
            int initial
                found := check_expression(&context, initial)
                if not failed(context) and found != variable.type
                    fail(&context, variable.name.position, "type mismatch in initialization of '{variable.name.text}'")
            none
                context.problem = none
        if failed(context)
            return
        id := add_variable(&context, statement.variable)
        .context.scopes[scope_index].set(variable.name.text, id)
    elif kind == "assignment"
        array_access := false
        match statement.index
            int expression_index
                array_access = true
            none
                array_access = false
        id := find_variable(&context, statement.name, array_access, false)
        if failed(context)
            return
        context.program.syntax.statements[index].reference = id
        match statement.index
            int expression_index
                found := check_expression(&context, expression_index)
                if not failed(context) and found != "int"
                    fail(&context, statement.position, "index of '{statement.name.text}' must be int")
            none
                context.problem = none
        if failed(context)
            return
        found := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        if not failed(context) and found != context.symbols[id].type
            fail(&context, statement.position, "type mismatch in assignment to '{statement.name.text}'")
    elif kind == "call"
        ignored := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0], true)
    elif kind == "if" or kind == "while"
        found := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
        if failed(context)
            return
        if found != "bool"
            fail(&context, statement.position, "condition of '{kind}' must be bool")
            return
        for child := statement.statements[]
            check_statement(&context, child, loops + (if kind == "while" then 1 else 0))
    elif kind == "for"
        context.scopes = context.scopes.append(map<string, int>())
        if statement.statements[0] >= 0
            check_statement(&context, statement.statements[0], loops)
        if not failed(context) and statement.expressions[0] >= 0
            found := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
            if not failed(context) and found != "bool"
                fail(&context, statement.position, "condition of 'for' must be bool")
        if not failed(context) and statement.statements[1] >= 0
            check_statement(&context, statement.statements[1], loops)
        check_statement(&context, statement.statements[2], loops + 1)
        context.scopes = context.scopes[0:<int(#context.scopes) - 1]
    elif kind == "break" or kind == "continue"
        if loops == 0
            fail(&context, statement.position, "'{kind}' outside loop")
    elif kind == "return"
