        parser.Function function := context.program.syntax.functions[context.current_function]
        if function.type == "void" and #statement.expressions > 0
            fail(&context, statement.position, "function '{function.name.text}' must not return a value")
        elif function.type != "void"
            if #statement.expressions == 0
                fail(&context, statement.position, "function '{function.name.text}' must return a value")
            else
                found := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[0])
                if not failed(context) and found != function.type
                    fail(&context, statement.position, "return value of '{function.name.text}' must be {function.type}")
    elif kind == "print"
        for: position < int(#statement.expressions)
            found := check_expression(&context, statement.expressions[position])
            if failed(context)
                return
            if found != "int"
                fail(&context, statement.position, "argument {position + 1} of 'print' must be int")
                return
    elif kind == "block"
        context.scopes = context.scopes.append(map<string, int>())
        for child := statement.statements[]
            check_statement(&context, child, loops)
        context.scopes = context.scopes[0:<int(#context.scopes) - 1]

int | error global_id(const Context context, string name)
    match context.globals.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("missing global")

Context analyze(const parser.Program program)
    context := Context(program)
    for declaration := program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind == "variable"
            parser.Variable variable := program.syntax.variables[declaration.index]
            match variable.size
                int size
                    if variable.type != "int"
                        fail(&context, variable.name.position, "array '{variable.name.text}' must have element type int")
                    elif size == 0
                        match variable.size_position
                            lexer.Position position
                                fail(&context, position, "array '{variable.name.text}' must have a positive size")
                            none
                                fail(&context, variable.name.position, "array '{variable.name.text}' must have a positive size")
                none
                    if variable.type == "void"
                        fail(&context, variable.name.position, "variable '{variable.name.text}' cannot have type void")
            if failed(context)
                return context
            if context.globals.has(variable.name.text)
                fail(&context, variable.name.position, "redeclaration of '{variable.name.text}'")
                return context
            match variable.initializer
                int initial
                    invalid := forbidden(program.syntax, initial)
                    if #invalid > 0
                        earliest := invalid[0]
                        for position := invalid[]
                            if lexer.compare_position(position, earliest) < 0
                                earliest = position
                        fail(&context, earliest, "global initializer must be constant")
                        return context
                    found := check_expression(&context, initial)
                    if not failed(context) and found != variable.type
                        fail(&context, variable.name.position, "type mismatch in initialization of '{variable.name.text}'")
                none
                    context.problem = none
            if failed(context)
                return context
            id := add_variable(&context, declaration.index)
            .context.globals.set(variable.name.text, id)
        else
            parser.Function function := program.syntax.functions[declaration.index]
            if context.globals.has(function.name.text)
                fail(&context, function.name.position, "redeclaration of '{function.name.text}'")
                return context
            string[] names := []
            for parameter := function.parameters[]
                parser.Variable variable := program.syntax.variables[parameter]
                if variable.type == "void"
                    fail(&context, variable.name.position, "parameter '{variable.name.text}' cannot have type void")
                    return context
                if lexer.has(names, variable.name.text)
                    fail(&context, variable.name.position, "redeclaration of '{variable.name.text}'")
                    return context
                names = names.append(variable.name.text)
            id := add_function(&context, declaration.index)
            .context.globals.set(function.name.text, id)
    entry := -1
    match context.globals.get("main")
        int found
            if context.symbols[found].kind == "function"
                entry = context.symbols[found].index
        none
            entry = -1
    if entry < 0
        fail(&context, program.end, "no main function")
        return context
    parser.Function entry_function := context.program.syntax.functions[entry]
    if entry_function.type != "void" or #entry_function.parameters > 0
        fail(&context, entry_function.name.position, "main must be declared as 'void main()'")
        return context
    for declaration := program.declarations[]
        if declaration.kind != "function"
            continue
        context.current_function = declaration.index
        parser.Function function := context.program.syntax.functions[declaration.index]
        context.scopes = [map<string, int>()]
        for parameter := function.parameters[]
            id := add_variable(&context, parameter, true)
            string name := context.program.syntax.variables[parameter].name.text
            .context.scopes[0].set(name, id)
        parser.Stmt body := context.program.syntax.statements[function.body]
        for child := body.statements[]
            check_statement(&context, child, 0)
        if failed(context)
            return context
        if function.type != "void" and can_complete(context.program.syntax, function.body)
            fail(&context, function.name.position, "missing return in function '{function.name.text}'")
            return context
    context.current_function = -1
    context.scopes = []
    return context

import lexer = "./lexer.qui"
import codegen = "./codegen.qui"

class Frame(int[] locals, int return_address)
class Result(string[] output, int[] counts, int[] calls, int[][] edges, int executed, int max_stack, int max_depth, int | none error_pc, string | none message, int[] callers)

int pop(int[] &stack)
    value := stack[-1]
    stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
    return value

Result run(const codegen.Flat code, int area, const int[] input)
    globals := array(nat(area), fill = 0)
    int[] stack := []
    Frame[] frames := []
    counts := array(#code.instructions, fill = 0)
    calls := array(#code.starts, fill = 0)
    int[][] edges := array(#code.starts, fill = array(#code.starts, fill = 0))
    string[] output := []
    pc := 0
    read_position := 0
    executed := 0
    max_stack := 0
    max_depth := 0
    string | none message := none
    int | none error_pc := none
    while true
        if executed == 100000
            message = "instruction limit exceeded"
            error_pc = pc
            break
        codegen.Instruction instruction := code.instructions[pc]
        op := instruction.op
        operands := instruction.operands
        counts[pc] += 1
        executed += 1
        next := pc + 1
        frame_index := int(#frames) - 1
        if op == "PUSH"
            stack = stack.append(operands[0])
        elif op == "POP"
            ignored := pop(&stack)
        elif op == "LOADG"
            stack = stack.append(globals[operands[0]])
        elif op == "STOREG"
            globals[operands[0]] = pop(&stack)
        elif op == "LOADL"
            stack = stack.append(frames[frame_index].locals[operands[0]])
        elif op == "STOREL"
            frames[frame_index].locals[operands[0]] = pop(&stack)
        elif op == "LOADA" or op == "STOREA"
            value := if op == "STOREA" then pop(&stack) else 0
            index := pop(&stack)
            if index < 0 or index >= operands[1]
                message = "index {index} out of bounds for array of size {operands[1]}"
            elif op == "LOADA"
                stack = stack.append(globals[operands[0] + index])
            else
                globals[operands[0] + index] = value
        elif lexer.has(["ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "DIV", "MOD"], op)
            second := pop(&stack)
            first := pop(&stack)
            if (op == "DIV" or op == "MOD") and second == 0
                message = "division by zero"
            else
                value := if op == "ADD" then first + second elif op == "SUB" then first - second elif op == "MUL" then first * second elif op == "DIV" then first / second else first - second * (first / second)
                if value < -2147483648 or value > 2147483647
                    message = "integer overflow"
                else
                    stack = stack.append(value)
        elif op == "NEG"
            value := -pop(&stack)
            if value < -2147483648 or value > 2147483647
                message = "integer overflow"
            else
                stack = stack.append(value)
        elif op == "NOT"
            value := pop(&stack)
            stack = stack.append(if value == 0 then 1 else 0)
        elif lexer.has(["LT", "LE", "GT", "GE", "EQ", "NE"], op)
            second := pop(&stack)
            first := pop(&stack)
            value := if op == "LT" then first < second elif op == "LE" then first <= second elif op == "GT" then first > second elif op == "GE" then first >= second elif op == "EQ" then first == second else first != second
            stack = stack.append(if value then 1 else 0)
        elif op == "JUMP"
            next = operands[0]
        elif op == "JUMPF" or op == "JUMPT"
            value := pop(&stack)
            if (op == "JUMPF" and value == 0) or (op == "JUMPT" and value != 0)
                next = operands[0]
        elif op == "CALL"
            if #frames == 100
                message = "call depth limit exceeded"
            else
                count := operands[1]
                start := int(#stack) - count
                arguments := stack[start:<int(#stack)]
                stack = stack[0:<start]
                frames = frames.append(Frame(arguments, pc + 1))
                next = operands[0]
                unit := 0
                while code.starts[unit] != next
                    unit += 1
                calls[unit] += 1
                edges[code.owners[pc]][unit] += 1
        elif op == "ENTER"
            while int(#frames[frame_index].locals) < operands[0]
                frames[frame_index].locals = frames[frame_index].locals.append(0)
        elif op == "RET" or op == "RETV"
            next = frames[frame_index].return_address
            frames = frames[0:<frame_index]
        elif op == "READ"
            if read_position == int(#input)
                message = "read past end of input"
            else
                stack = stack.append(input[read_position])
                read_position += 1
        elif op == "PRINT"
            count := operands[0]
            start := int(#stack) - count
            string[] values := []
            for: start <= index < int(#stack)
                values = values.append(string(stack[index]))
            stack = stack[0:<start]
            output = output.append(values.join(" "))
        elif op == "HALT"
            max_stack = lexer.maximum(max_stack, int(#stack))
            max_depth = lexer.maximum(max_depth, int(#frames))
            break
        failed := false
        match message
            string reason
                failed = true
            none
                failed = false
        if failed
            error_pc = pc
            break
        max_stack = lexer.maximum(max_stack, int(#stack))
        max_depth = lexer.maximum(max_depth, int(#frames))
        pc = next
    int[] callers := []
    index := int(#frames) - 1
    while index >= 1
        callers = callers.append(frames[index].return_address - 1)
        index -= 1
    return Result(output, counts, calls, edges, executed, max_stack, max_depth, error_pc, message, callers)
